verdict.rationale: Mailgun's docs explicitly describe an official MCP server that lets any MCP-compatible AI assistant manage the Mailgun account conversationally (send emails, check stats, manage domains, troubleshoot DNS), confirmed by a documentation page and probe. This is first-party documentation is solid but lacks independent/hands-on corroboration of real-world MCP usage. missing for 10: independent/community verification of the MCP server working in practice, details on setup/auth robustness.
